程序包 com.ta.recruitment.model

类 Job

java.lang.Object
com.ta.recruitment.model.Job
public class Job extends Object
Represents a TA job posting created by a Module Organiser (MO).

Status values: "active" (visible to TAs), "deactive" (hidden from TAs, visible to owner MO), "closed" (admin-only visibility). The openings field sets the maximum number of accepted TAs; defaults to 1.

      public Map<String,String> toMap()
